title: helianthemum guttatum f. plantagineum
intro: Helianthemum guttatum f. plantagineum, commonly known as Rockrose or Frostweed, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Rockrose family (Cistaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum guttatum f. plantagineum include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
